subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
The main antagonist in a movie.
solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. Villain .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Villain** refers to the main antagonist in a movie or story. This character opposes the protagonist and is typically responsible for creating conflict or obstacles.
 
• The option **Hero** refers to the main character or protagonist who usually represents good and strives to resolve the conflict.
 
• The term **Protagonist** refers to the main character in a story, who is typically the central figure driving the narrative forward, often in opposition to the villain.
 
• The word **Sidekick** refers to a supporting character who assists the protagonist but does not play the role of the antagonist.

Correct sentence: *The main antagonist in a movie is called a **Villain**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Villain:**

 
 
• The term is commonly used in literature, films, and plays to refer to the character opposing the protagonist.
 
• Examples include characters such as Lord Voldemort in the Harry Potter series or Thanos in the Marvel Cinematic Universe.
 
 
 
• **Protagonist:**
 
 
• The protagonist is the central character, often representing good, who drives the story forward by overcoming challenges created by the antagonist.
 
• Examples include Harry Potter in the Harry Potter series or Frodo Baggins in The Lord of the Rings.
